tenet.dev.tools.help.progress: Show the completion bar under each chapter's name.
tenet.dev.tools.help.palette: The palettes this pack ships; a press replaces the current look.
tenet.dev.tools.help.palette_row: Switch to this palette. It clears manual edits.
tenet.dev.tools.help.shape: The look's own shape: one knob, the corner radius.
tenet.dev.tools.help.prefs: How this client edits: nothing here is saved into the pack.
tenet.dev.tools.help.radius: Corner radius of panels, nodes and buttons.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas: What is drawn over the canvas colour. Press to fold.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_pattern: Flat, or a pattern drawn from arithmetic. An image names a file.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_texture: The image file: type or paste an id, or press … to browse the pack.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_fit: Tile repeats the image; Cover draws it once, cropped to the rectangle.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_tile: How wide one repeat is drawn, in pixels. The height keeps the file's aspect.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_size: Edge of a dot or speck, and the thickness of a line or hatch.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_density: One cell in this many carries a speck.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_direction: Which way the hatch's diagonal leans.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_spacing: Distance between repeats: content units under Graph, pixels under Screen.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_ink: The colour the pattern is drawn in. Its alpha is how loud the pattern is.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_space: Graph moves the pattern with the content; Screen pins it to the surface.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_opacity: The ink's alpha, in percent: how loud the pattern is.
tenet.dev.tools.help.canvas_copy: Write this canvas into every chapter's own theme. Each write is its own undo step.
tenet.dev.tools.help.colours: Every colour the theme defines; a press picks one to edit below.
tenet.dev.tools.help.book: The pack's book: its name and icon. Press to fold. Ctrl+Z does not cover this block.
tenet.dev.tools.help.book_title: The name shown at the top of the book, in place of the pack's own.
tenet.dev.tools.help.book_icon: The item shown beside the name. Empty draws none.
tenet.dev.tools.help.book_lod: Draw every chapter without the zoom tiers: icons, rings, titles and badges at any zoom. A chapter opts back into tiers with its own switch.
tenet.dev.tools.help.book_starter: Give every player a quest book the first time they join: one book in the first free slot, never overwritten, never again.
tenet.dev.tools.help.appearance: Everything under here writes this chapter's own look. Press to fold.

tenet.dev.chapter.subtitle: Subtitle
tenet.dev.link.help.target: The quest this marker points at, by id or alias. A name that resolves to nothing is reported at load.
tenet.dev.link.help.place: Where the marker sits on the canvas, in canvas pixels. A drag moves it; a number places it.
tenet.dev.link.help.shape: The node's shape. Absent draws as the target quest does.
tenet.dev.link.help.size: The node's size in pixels. Absent draws at the target quest's size.
tenet.dev.link.help.pick: Point this link at a quest by clicking one on the canvas. Escape cancels.
tenet.dev.link.help.jump: Open the target quest's card, switching chapters when it lives elsewhere.
tenet.dev.link.help.delete: Remove this link from the chapter. Like every delete here, it asks twice.
tenet.dev.element.title: Caption
tenet.dev.element.click_none: No press action — choose When Pressed to add one
tenet.dev.element.section.caption: Caption
tenet.dev.element.lower_tip: Draw one step earlier, under one more element
tenet.dev.element.raise_tip: Draw one step later, over one more element
tenet.dev.element.help.position: Where it sits on the canvas, in canvas pixels. A drag moves it; a number places it.
tenet.dev.element.help.fixed: Positioned with the canvas like anything on it, but the size is canvas pixels at zoom one: grows and shrinks with the zoom like a node.
tenet.dev.element.help.endpoints: Where the line starts and ends, in canvas pixels. Drag an endpoint on the canvas, or type it here.
tenet.dev.element.help.size: How far it reaches. A line's Width is how thick it is drawn, where a box's is its reach.
tenet.dev.element.help.rotation: How far the picture is turned, in degrees. Drag the grip above it, or type the angle.
tenet.dev.element.help.corner: Whether the picture turns about its corner rather than its middle.
tenet.dev.element.help.alpha: How see-through the picture is, from invisible to solid.
tenet.dev.element.help.order: Where it sits in the draw order. Higher draws later, on top. Lower and Raise step it one rung.
tenet.dev.element.help.dev: Whether players see it at all. On, it is a draft only authors see.
tenet.dev.element.help.requires: The quest that must be completed before readers see this, by id. Empty means always shown.
tenet.dev.element.help.border_width: How thick the box's border is drawn.
tenet.dev.element.help.source: What the picture shows. A file from the pack, or a block sprite — one or the other, never both.
tenet.dev.element.help.caption: Words painted onto the picture, and how they sit on it.
tenet.dev.element.help.words: What the text says, how big it draws, and its colour.
tenet.dev.element.help.look: How it is drawn rather than what it is.
tenet.dev.element.help.line: How thick the line is, and what sits on its end.
tenet.dev.element.help.locked: Whether the editor's drag leaves this picture where it is. On, grips and moves do nothing — readers see no difference.
tenet.dev.element.help.press: What a press does: which kind, and the quest, page or command it acts on. None carries no target.
tenet.dev.element.help.show: Where it sits in the draw order, whether it is a draft, and what it waits for.
tenet.dev.chapter.missing_copy: The chapter's copy has not arrived yet
tenet.dev.chapter.missing_copy_said: The chapter's copy has not arrived yet — the server said: %s
tenet.dev.chapter.help.title: The chapter's name, in the sidebar and the book's header.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.subtitle: One line under the name, wherever the chapter introduces itself.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.icon: The item the chapter shows as its icon. Press to pick one.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.aliases: Other ids that resolve to this chapter, separated by commas — for renames and old saves.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.tags: Words this chapter answers to in lookups by tag, separated by commas. A lookup of #tag resolves to the first object carrying it.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.progression: Whether this chapter's quests may be done in any order (flexible) or only in the order they are authored (linear).
tenet.dev.chapter.help.consume_items: Whether a quest's tasks take the items they ask for, unless the quest says otherwise.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.flexible_progress: Whether this chapter's quests may work their tasks before their dependencies are met, unless a quest says otherwise.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.prerequisite: How many of a quest's prerequisites must be met before it may start, unless the quest sets its own mode.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.auto_claim: Whether this chapter's quests hand their rewards over on completion, unless a quest overrides it. The unset state defers to the pack's own setting.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.gate_mode: What this chapter's own dependencies have to reach before the chapter opens: all or any of them, completed or merely started.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.gate_min: How many of the chapters this one waits on must be satisfied. Empty means the mode decides. Never more than the list holds.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.depends_on: The chapters this one waits on, by id, separated by commas. A name that resolves to nothing is reported at load, and it means this chapter can never open.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.completes_when: The quests that finish this chapter, by id, separated by commas — every one of them, and a repeatable quest counts after its first completion. Empty means the chapter never reports completed, which is fine unless another chapter waits on it as completed.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.hide_until_deps: Whether the chapter is left out of the book until its own dependencies are met. Off, it is listed dimmed with what it is waiting for.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.always_invisible: Whether this chapter is withheld from every reader, whatever its gate says. The gate itself is unaffected, and an author still sees the row.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.lod_off: Whether this chapter draws without the zoom tiers: icons, rings, titles and badges at any zoom. Off defers to the book's own switch; on draws everything always.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.default_hide_deps: Whether the quests in this chapter are hidden until their own prerequisites are met, unless a quest says otherwise. A quest can still turn it off for itself.
Whether the quests in this chapter are hidden until one of their prerequisites is visible, unless a quest says otherwise.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.default_min_width: How wide this chapter's quests want their detail panel unless one says otherwise. A quest's own width wins; 0 means the panel kind decides.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.sequential_tasks: Whether this chapter's quests require their tasks in order unless a quest says otherwise.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.autofocus: The quest this chapter centres on when it is selected, by id or alias in this chapter. Empty centres on the whole chapter.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.line_form: The chapter's default line shape — what a line resets to when it uses the chapter default.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.line_head: The default shape drawn at the end of a line.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.line_place: Where a line's arrowhead sits: at the target, at both ends, or repeated along the line.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.line_density: How many arrowheads a repeating line draws.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.line_pattern: The default line pattern — solid, or one of the decorative ones.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.group_title: The name of the group this chapter belongs to.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.group_icon: The group's own icon. Unset, it borrows the first chapter's.
tenet.dev.chapter.help.group_collapsed: Whether the group starts folded in the sidebar.
tenet.dev.template.empty: No templates yet — open a task and press its star
tenet.dev.quest.help.default: Shape, size, placement and rules — the fields the reader's card does not show.
tenet.dev.help.shape: The node's outline. A click lands on exactly the pixels it draws.
tenet.dev.help.rotation: How far the node is turned, in degrees clockwise.
tenet.dev.help.size: How big the node draws on the canvas: 16 to 512 pixels.
tenet.dev.help.icon_scale: How much of the node the icon fills; the outline caps it.
tenet.dev.help.icon: The item in the middle of the node.
tenet.dev.help.show_title: Draw the quest's name under its node.
tenet.dev.help.position: Canvas position. Drag the node on the canvas, or type a number.
tenet.dev.help.repeatable: A repeatable quest can be completed again after its cooldown.
tenet.dev.help.repeat_cooldown: Ticks between completions. 2400 is two minutes.
tenet.dev.help.sequential_tasks: Tasks must be handed in in order.
tenet.dev.help.exclusive_group: Quests sharing a group lock each other out for good.
tenet.dev.help.prerequisite_mode: How many prerequisites must be satisfied: all, or any one.
tenet.dev.help.min_required: An exact count, for an "any three of five". 0 uses the rule.
tenet.dev.help.max_dependents: How many quests may complete off this one. 0 is no cap.
tenet.dev.help.optional: Marks a side quest. It still gates its dependants like any other quest.
tenet.dev.help.flexible_progress: Tasks may be worked on before the dependencies are met; completion still waits for them.
tenet.dev.help.add_selected: Add every node selected on the canvas as a prerequisite.
tenet.dev.help.pick_on_canvas: Arm the canvas: the next node clicked is added.
tenet.dev.help.visible_after_tasks: With Invisible on: shown once this many tasks have progress.
tenet.dev.help.hide_until_deps_done: Hidden until this quest's prerequisites are met.
tenet.dev.help.hide_until_deps_shown: Hidden until at least one prerequisite is itself shown.
tenet.dev.help.hide_dependency_lines: Do not draw the lines arriving at this quest.
tenet.dev.help.hide_dependent_lines: Do not draw the lines leaving this quest for its dependants.
tenet.dev.help.min_width: How wide this quest's detail panel wants to be. 0 uses the chapter's default, then the panel kind's.
tenet.dev.help.disable_toast: Completing this quest raises no toast. Either this or a silent auto-claim mode quiets it.
tenet.dev.help.ignore_reward_blocking: This quest's rewards keep flowing while the team's payouts are held. Either the quest's flag or a reward's own flag exempts that reward.
tenet.dev.help.disable_recipe_mod: Recipe viewers (JEI, REI, EMI) do not list this quest. Unset follows the file's default; either choice wins over it.
tenet.dev.help.hide_lock_icon: This quest wears no padlock on the canvas when it is locked. The file can hide every mark with showLockIcons; either silence wins.
tenet.dev.help.hide_text_until_done: The card shows no description until it is completed.
tenet.dev.help.hide_details_until_starta: The card shows no task details until it can be started.
tenet.dev.help.id: The quest's id. Renaming it needs an alias: progress files name it.
tenet.dev.help.aliases: Other names this quest answers to, comma-separated.
tenet.dev.help.tags: Words this quest answers to in lookups by tag, comma-separated. A lookup of #tag resolves to the first object carrying it.
tenet.dev.help.guide_page: The guide book page this quest belongs to. A reference the quest card shows; Tenet has no guide integration.
